title: Darwinbox
bio: Darwinbox provides cloud-based human capital management software for hiring, core HR, payroll and performance management in large organizations.

title: DataCamp
bio: Online learning platform offering interactive courses in data science, analytics, Python, R, SQL and artificial intelligence.

title: Deel
bio: Deel provides payroll, HR and compliance software that helps companies hire and pay employees and contractors in many countries.

title: DEGIRO
bio: DEGIRO is an online broker offering European investors low-cost access to stocks, ETFs, bonds, options and futures on many exchanges.

title: Depop
bio: Depop is a British resale app where users buy and sell secondhand and vintage clothing, accessories and streetwear.

title: DHgate
bio: DHgate is a Chinese cross-border online marketplace where buyers purchase wholesale and retail goods directly from manufacturers and sellers.

title: Discord
bio: Communication platform for text, voice and video chat in community servers and private groups, widely used by gamers.

title: Docker
bio: Docker makes tools for building, sharing and running applications in software containers, including Docker Desktop and Docker Hub.

title: Doctolib
bio: Doctolib is a French platform for booking medical appointments and video consultations, providing scheduling software to doctors in Europe.

title: Dott
bio: Shared micromobility operator renting electric scooters and e-bikes through its app in European cities.

title: Dubizzle
bio: Dubizzle is a classifieds platform in the UAE where people list cars, property, jobs and secondhand goods for sale.

title: DuckDuckGo
bio: DuckDuckGo offers a privacy-focused search engine and web browser that do not build personal profiles of users.

title: EBANX
bio: EBANX provides payment processing that lets international companies accept local payment methods from customers in Latin America and other markets.

title: Emma Sleep
bio: Emma Sleep is a German company selling foam and hybrid mattresses, pillows and bed frames, mainly online.

title: Flexport
bio: American freight forwarder and customs broker that manages ocean, air and truck shipments for importers through an online platform.

title: FlixBus
bio: German intercity bus service selling low-cost coach tickets online for routes across Europe and North America.

title: FreeNow
bio: FreeNow is a Hamburg-based app for booking taxis and private hire rides in cities across Europe.

title: Freetrade
bio: Freetrade is a UK investing app for buying shares, ETFs and investment trusts in general accounts, ISAs and pensions.

title: GetYourGuide
bio: Online marketplace for booking tours, attractions, activities and experiences at travel destinations worldwide.

title: Glossier
bio: American beauty brand selling skincare, makeup and fragrance such as Boy Brow, Cloud Paint and Glossier You online and in stores.

title: Glovo
bio: Spanish delivery app that brings restaurant meals, groceries and other local store items to customers in Europe, Africa and Asia.

title: GoCardless
bio: GoCardless provides bank payment services that let businesses collect recurring and one-off payments directly from customers' bank accounts.

title: Gopuff
bio: American delivery service selling snacks, groceries, drinks and household essentials from its own micro-fulfilment centres.

title: GoStudent
bio: Austrian online tutoring company that matches school students with tutors for one-to-one video lessons across many subjects.

title: Grammarly
bio: Grammarly offers a writing assistant that checks grammar, spelling, clarity and tone across browsers, apps and documents.

title: Great Learning
bio: Indian online education company offering professional courses in data science, artificial intelligence and management with university partners, plus free courses.

title: greytHR
bio: greytHR provides cloud-based HR and payroll software for small and medium-sized businesses in India and other countries.

title: GulfTalent
bio: GulfTalent is an online recruitment platform listing professional jobs in the Gulf countries and connecting employers with experienced candidates.

title: Gusto
bio: Gusto provides online payroll, benefits and HR software for small and medium-sized businesses in the United States.
